summary: Arm Holdings plc filed a Form 6-K containing its quarterly earnings press release and shareholder letter for the first quarter of fiscal year 2027 ended June 30, 2026. The filing reports record revenue of $1.29 billion, up 22% year-over-year, with non-GAAP EPS of $0.45, above guidance. No terms such as price per share, premium, or deal mechanics are present, as this is a standard earnings communication. There is no merger, acquisition, restructuring, or other special-situations event. The filing is a routine periodic report of financial results, with no structural change or catalyst. What to watch: earnings call transcript for forward guidance on AI demand and Arm AGI CPU ramp.
